The Problem

Social media
broke something.

Algorithms optimised for outrage. Feeds that mix grief with memes. No transparency. No control. CxCix is the correction.

Algorithm-Driven Outrage
Platforms push emotionally extreme content because it drives clicks — not because it benefits you.
Zero Emotional Control
You have no say in the emotional tone of your feed. One scroll mixes grief, comedy, politics, and ads.
Chaotic Comment Sections
Every reply thread devolves into noise. No structure, no intent, no clarity — just chaos.
Hidden Black-Box Algorithms
You can't see or control how content is filtered. The algorithm works for advertisers, not you.
Emotional Environments

Six moods. Your rules.

Switch between six distinct emotional environments. Each has its own content tone, visual identity, and interaction style.

Calm
Peaceful, reflective content. Mindful posts, nature, slow thoughts, and supportive vibes for when you need to decompress.
Serious
Analytical, educational, informational. News, deep dives, research, and intellectual discussion.
Creative
Art, design, music, innovative ideas, and original expression. A space for builders, makers, and dreamers.
Satire
Humor, memes, parody, and wit. Laugh at the world without drowning in it.
Debate
Structured arguments, opinions, counterpoints, and constructive conflict. Engage without the chaos.
Vawulence
Intense, unfiltered, chaotic. For when you want raw energy, bold takes, and zero sugar-coating.
Core Features

Built different.
Built for you.

Smart Feed
Personal AI Moderator
Your own AI that learns your preferences and filters content based on your current mood — not what drives clicks for advertisers.
Real-Time
Instant Mood Switch
Tap once and your entire feed transforms. Content, tone, and interactions adapt immediately to match your emotional state.
Self-Awareness
Mood Passport
AI-generated insights about your emotional patterns. Understand when creativity peaks, what you avoid, and how your mood evolves.
Clarity
Structured Comments
AI classifies every reply — Support, Counterpoint, Question, Build, Reflect — so conversations have clarity, not just volume.
Transparency
Shift: Repost with Intent
Unlike a blank repost, Shift requires you to declare your perspective before sharing — Agree, Disagree, Add Context, Satire, Challenge. Every share carries meaning. No more blind amplification.
